english: Haaah... I'm in trouble here.
I'm always strugglin' with this.\nWhat'd I do to deserve this...
Chris?\nWhat's wrong?
Nothin'...\nMust be nice, bein' so carefree...
Fine, guess I'll go lookin' outside again...
(She's wanderin' off again...)
(Hibiki and Sonico talk to her, but\nI don't think I've ever seen her\ntalk to someone on her own...)
(If I remember right, it was over here...)
...Hey.
Whoa!?
I figured someone was followin' me, and\nsure enough, it's you...\nYour tailin' skills suck.
Ever heard 'curiosity killed the cat'?\nSneakin' around after people —\nwhat's that about?
N-No, I wasn't tailing you!\nYou came over this way, so I wondered\nif something was up...
What, you're just a busybody, huh...\nOne of those is plenty enough as is.
Nothin' special...\nI just wanted to be alone, that's all.
I'm no good at playin' friends.\nTake a hint.
Still, you didn't have to come out to\nsome middle-of-nowhere spot like this...\nHuh!
...Tch.
Th-The bathroom?
Hell no!\nAre you stupid!?
Oh, a secret rendezvous?
Huh?\nWith who, exactly?
Why're YOU blushin', dammit!\nGross!
You're weird!\nJust leave me alone already!
Don't follow me!\nIf you do, I'll shoot you dead!
I got yelled at...\nBut why does she really avoid everyone like that...?
It's almost mealtime.\nI wonder what today's is... huh?
...\nRan into that pain in the ass again.
I-I wasn't peekin' inside or nothin'.\nI was just standin' here!\nI like standin' here, that's all!
...??\nIt's mealtime, right?\nDon't be shy — why don't you go inside?
I-I'm fine, dammit!
...Who's there!?
You...?\nWhat d'you want!?
Chris, you haven't eaten yet, right?
Not yet, but...
What's that you're holdin'...?\nWh-What're you plannin'!?\nI didn't ask for nothin'!
It's fine, here you go.\nBut why don't you eat with everyone...?
I used to be the enemy...\nI got no right takin' charity.
(Ah, so maybe she just can't bring herself to join the group...?)
Up till now?\nWell, I managed somehow.\nFindin' food around the place...
Hibiki or Sonico'd bring me stuff, y'know.
So they forgot about you today.\nAnd that's why you're here alone, all lonely...
Sh-Shut up!\nDid you come here to mock me!?
S-Sorry!
You should go get it yourself sometimes.\nMakin' people run errands for you isn't good.
They do that on their own...
And when they forget,\nI go get the leftovers!
But there's someone who eats a ton, so\nthere's usually nothin' left...
A-Ahaha...
Anyway, someone like me — a former enemy —\neatin' side by side with them?\nThat's oversteppin'.
That's why I'm here alone.\nDon't tell the others\nabout this, got it?
I think you're overthinking it... Anyway, here you go.
...I'll take it.
Nom, nom...!
(This is like feedin' a stray cat...)
...Phew, that was good.
I'll go clean this up, then.
...Th-thanks.
Huh?
N-Nothin'!\nI ain't sayin' thanks or nothin',\nnow get outta here!
...Sheesh, what's takin' so long?\nWhat's she doin' over there?
Oh, you're finally here.
Too slow!\nI'm starvin' over here!
Y-Yes!\nSorry I took so long,\nthank you for waiting!
(...Huh? Isn't something off here?)
Well, generous as I am,\nI'll forgive ya.\nNow hurry up and hand it over.
Today's looks tasty.\nNo way am I touchin' those sketchy wild berries\nagain...
Hm? What's that you got there?
This is the dessert I won at rock-paper-scissors...
Heh... looks tasty!\nGive me some.
Wait, there's only one...?\nEh, whatever, I'll take it!
Ate it all, ate it all...\nI'm stuffed.
What's with that look...\nDon't be mad, I already apologized for\neatin' your share too, didn't I?
A-Ahaha...\nMore importantly, won't you eat with everyone?
Well, that's, y'know...\nI ain't mentally ready yet...
Hm? Did you hear somethin'?
A stray cat, maybe...?
Sounds like it.\nWhere?
That was your stomach growling, Chris...
No way.\nHow big an eater\ndo you think I am?
It's the stray cat.\nWhere is it?
Found it, found it.\nIt was hidin' in a place like this.
Caught ya...\nHm, still just a kitten.
Oh, what's this little guy?\nFriendly fella, huh...
H-Hey, don't lick me.\nHaha, you wanna be friends with me?
(She's not a bad person, Chris...)
Hm, what's that?\nYeah yeah, I got it, I got it.
Hey.
Yes?
This little guy looks hungry —\ngo fetch somethin' for it to eat.
Holdin' you like this is nice and warm...\nYou think so too, right?
But man,\nyour fur's pretty clean.\nMaybe you're a fancy abandoned cat?
Chriiiis...\nHuh, that cat?
Alright, I get it.\nI'll help you look for your mama.\nSo...
W-Whoa, you!\nDon't just pop out like that!
I-I wasn't just\nplayin' around with it just now...\nit did that on its own!
So you've been keepin' up with carin' for the cat.
Yeah, that's right, I kept at it.\nThe little thing got attached to me,\nas you can see.
It keeps followin' me around persistently,\nand it's cu— ugh, what a pain in the ass!
(Easy for you to say with that big smile...)
Hey, do you know anythin' about takin' care of cats?\nDidn't think so... this is a problem.
Somethin's wrong with this one.\nWhatever I give it,\nit won't eat.
It ain't sick or somethin', is it...?\nHey, what do you think?
Hm?
It's meowin' again!\nWh-What do I do!?
It's a kitten —\nit probably wants milk.
If only someone could nurse it...
Nurse...?
What're you sayin'!?\nLike I'd be producin' any!
(That's not what I meant!\n...Though she probably WOULD nurse it if she could...)
You should hold it more gently...\nYou're squeezin' it too hard against your chest.
My chest...!?\nWhere are you lookin', dammit!?
Huh!?\nI-I didn't mean it like that,\nit just looked like it was sufferin'!
Just do somethin' about it!\nIt's so loud I can't take it!
R-Right!\nI'll go get some milk!
There, there, stop cryin'~.
I get it, you're lonely too.\nThen I'll be\nyour mama instead.
Don't worry...\nI won't ever\nabandon you...
Here, milk.\nDrink lots and grow up big.
There, there...
You're drinkin' a lot.\nYou must've been hungry.
While we were away from town,\nyou were lonely, huh?
Then I'll stay with you today.\nGuess I'll crash here too!
So that's the deal.\nSorry, but head on back first.
...Um, Chris.
Hm, what?
Well, um, maybe you should\ntake the stray-cat care\nin moderation?
...What's that supposed to mean?
If you get too attached...
You're sayin' this little guy\nwon't be able to live on its own?
You're tellin' me to abandon it!?
If you're gonna let go, sooner is better...
No!!\nI won't abandon it!
Even I know...\nthat we can't stay together\nforever...
I'm gonna leave this place someday,\nI know I can't take care of it\nforever.
Then why...?
Maybe it's just my selfishness...
But right now, I want to do\neverything I can for this little guy...
Abandonin' it before that —\nI just can't bring myself to do it.
In that case...
Don't say another word!\nI... I wouldn't do that!
...If I betray it now...\nwhat would it have left to believe in...?\nAbandon it? Like hell I could!
Huh?\nNo, we ain't fightin'.
...See, it looks like it wants to\nstay together a little longer too.
So just give me a little more time to think.\nPlease...
Understood, I said too much.\nLet's watch over it a while longer.
Hah, hah...\nHey, you there!?
Chris?\nWhy are you in such a rush, what happened?
Hey, I found you!\nLend me a hand!
That cat's gone missin'!\nHelp me look for it!
It always shows up around this time\nand rubs up against me...!
R-Right.\nFor starters, let's check the places it usually hangs around.
Hah, hah... dammit.
Not here either...?\nDammit, where'd it go!?
If it wandered outta town...\nwho knows what'll happen to it...!
It'll be okay, Chris.\nI'm sure it'll come back soon.
You...
Did YOU dump it somewhere!?\nTo get it away from me!?
C-Calm down!\nI'd never do something like that...
S-Sorry... I just...
I don't know what to do anymore,\nmy head's all messed up...
Chris...\nWhy are you so hung up on that little one?
See, someone picked me up once,\nbut then they threw me away...
Bein' thrown away hurts.\nEven if you hate 'em, you can't fully hate 'em...\nit's that love-hate thing that eats at you.
That's why I hate it.\nDoin' the abandonin' AND bein' abandoned...!
(Right, if I remember, Chris...)
I see... now I finally get it.
Figures — turns out I was the one\nclingin's to it... some punchline, huh.
What a joke I am...
I understand how you feel.\nJust a little...
Come to think of it, you too —\nyou're sufferin' 'cause you lost your memories, right...
(I don't know what to say to her...)
Sorry I snapped at you...\nAfter all the help\nyou've given me...
I'm just this kinda pain-in-the-ass person.\nYou can be fed up with me, I don't mind.
That's not true.
Heh, you're such a carefree guy...
...I'll wait here a little longer.\nSorry, but leave me alone for now.
Okay... good night.
The cat... hasn't come back.
...Yeah.
Chris...
Don't make that face!\nI'm not depressed anymore,\nand I'm not mad either.
It probably went back\nto its mama.
If it'd stayed with me forever,\nit would've turned into a kid\nwho can't do anythin' alone.
So this is for the best.
Yes, I think so too.
But now I'm all alone again.\nBein' alone is lonely, huh...
That's not true.
Whaddaya mean?
Don't tell me you're about to say\nsomethin' like you think of me\nas a friend?
That was exactly the plan.\nYou figured me out, huh?
You're not alone, Chris.\nBecause you've got friends.
Y-You... you're the kinda guy who can\nsay stuff like that with a straight face...\nIt really throws me off.
H-Huh, is that weird...?
Yeah, you're a weird one.
But, well... thanks.
Talkin' with you,\nI get this warm feelin'...\ncould this be...?
Huh?
N-Nothin'!
Y-Yes!\nSorry!
Well, anyway...\ntake care of me from now on.
We're... friends, right?
(She admitted I'm her friend...)
Hm? What's with the grin.\nDon't get cocky and\nstart actin' all buddy-buddy, got it?
...Hehe, sheesh.\nLook at that happy face of yours.
(No matter how you look at it, Chris is the one who looks happy...\nbut I'll keep that to myself.)
